title: Senior Product Designer
intro: Our client roster is growing fast (aviation, robotics, automation). We need another product thinker who can tame heavy data, ship weekly, and keep things effortlessly human.
workOn: Partner with CEOs, PMs, and engineers from day zero—no silos.
UX: Run lean discovery: map jobs-to-be-done, interview users, mine insights, create userflows.
UI: Sketch → wireframe → prototype → polish in Figma; ship slices every week. This is a visual work.
UI: Design bite-size interactions and micro-animations that explain themselves.
bring: Portfolio that shows systems thinking and pixel craft. We are not looking for Landing pages or brand design examples.
Perfect blend of Product thinking and Visual design.
Able to explain design trade-offs in fully fluent English.
Genuine curiosity for robotics, AI, or aviation—or the hunger to learn fast.
niceToHave: Motion chops (Principle, Rive, Lottie, After Effects).
howWeWork: Weekly “Design Together” sessions with clients—zero waiting weeks for feedback.
Twice-weekly Slack updates keep pulses steady.
Small senior team, flat hierarchy, big ownership.
We meet once a year in different parts of the world to connect, plan, and reset.
applySteps: One project you’re proud of & why (tweet length)
outro: If you’re ready to turn robots and AI into products humans adore, we’d love to meet you.
